_comment: Versions are auto-updated by check_versions.sh. URLs are editable here by hand — all build scripts read them, so download links can be changed without touching any script. Each 'url' is an ordered mirror list, tried in turn. Placeholders: {VERSION}, {ARCH}.

xcvm_core._note: LEGACY C build (frozen). The old ionCube/OpenSSL C extension under bin/xcvm_core/, last synced by the C-era pipeline (2.1.1 was the final C release). No longer updated — the extension repo now ships the Rust rewrite under 'xcvm_extention'. Kept so installs pinned to the C build keep resolving.

xcvm_extention._note: Rust rewrite of the PHP extension, built in the XC_VM_CoreExtention repo (not here). Self-contained .so (per-PHP-version groups php8.1/php8.4, no OpenSSL/libsodium linkage). Stamped automatically by .github/workflows/sync-xcvm-core.yml when a new release is pulled into bin/xcvm_extention/. Single source of truth for the installed Rust extension version.
